post.originalText:
DAY 1. I ASKED OPUS 5.5 FOR A GAME YOU CAN'T PUT DOWN

under 3 hours of opus later: skyhold. the sky islands are falling and you're the last builder

houses arrive by balloon, one at a time. no skipping

> drop a tower on the east and the island leans
> past 15° the rim starts sliding into the clouds
> lose 5 houses and the whole island flips
> the only counterweight is a balloon

5 islands, 5 keepers, and a daily island that's the same for everyone

7,511 lines of three.js. no assets: every house, cloud and keeper is drawn in code

play it free: https://t.co/xwaajhksAs

sourceMaterials.text: @arixxbt that's the plan. day 2 is a leaderboard for the daily: same seed for everyone, so the scores actually compare
sourceMaterials.author: 0xbobaaa

sourceMaterials.text: @diancodes close. the pull was right, at the tie point. but its -3 also went into the island's total mass, so 20 balloons left almost no mass and any small offset became 22°
sourceMaterials.author: 0xbobaaa

sourceMaterials.text: @diancodes mostly first pass. the one bug: balloons subtracted from the island's mass, so 20 of them tipped a level island to 22°. one-line fix
sourceMaterials.author: 0xbobaaa

sourceMaterials.text: @scrblanc fixed 1/60 s step with an accumulator, and the 15° slide counts 2 s of sim time, so 144hz plays the same island
sourceMaterials.author: 0xbobaaa

sourceMaterials.text: @glitchedge the whole design is one no: you can't skip a piece. the hold slot is the only way out
sourceMaterials.author: 0xbobaaa

sourceMaterials.text: @0xWast3 no registration required, just go to the site and play
sourceMaterials.author: 0xbobaaa

sourceMaterials.text:
Skyhold














  
    skyhold
    @0xbobaaa
  

  
    
      
        written by opus 5.5 · free in the browser

        Skyhold

        The sky islands are falling. Houses arrive by balloon, one at a time, and you drop each one where it keeps the island level.

        
          Play in the browser
          The five islands
        

        3–6 minute runs · mouse or touch · saves itself

      

      
        
        sound on
      

    


    
      
        today's island · same for everyone

        One island. Everyone. Today.

        Today's twistloading...

        
          Play today's island
        

        new island every day at 00:00 UTC · no sign-up to play

      

      
        Loading today's board...

        

      

    


    
      The island has a centre of mass

      Every building has a weight, and the island leans toward the heavy side. Drag the slider to load the east side and watch the gauge.

      
        

        0.0°level

        Houses on the east side: 0
        
      

      
        15° · 2 sthe low rim starts sliding into the clouds

        5 fallsor 19° for 3 s and the island flips

        x1.5score while the gauge stays green

      

      opus: a castle. weight 6. right in the middle, please

    

    
      How a run works

      You do not choose what to build. The balloon brings the next piece, the card on the right shows the one after it, and a slow drop lands on a random edge.

      
        Cottageweight 1the easy start, needs a road

        Towerweight 4big score, big lean

        Castleweight 6 · 2x2put it in the middle

        Balloonweight −3rare, the only counterweight

        Holdone slotswap a piece you cannot place yet

        Park2x2+2 for every home next to it

        Bakerycombo+5 when it touches three homes

        Gustsfrom 40–60 sstronger every minute

        Gluerarethe next 3 buildings can't slide off

        Wind Vanerareturns the next gust away

      

    

    
      Five islands, five keepers

      Each chapter is a new island shape with one request. Stars buy perks. Chapter 1 unlocks steampunk, chapter 3 unlocks cyber, and chapter 5 opens Endless. The Daily island is open from your first visit, with a board for the day.

      
        chapter 1 · Pip the bakerMeadowfall
Keep 12 homes standing until sunset.

        chapter 3 · Tamsin the lamplighterHollow Ring
A ring with a hole in it. Light the lighthouse before the storm.

        chapter 4 · Bram & BeaThe Twins
Two islands on one rope bridge. Weight on one moves both.

      

    

    
      Build log

      Each day Opus 5.5 gets the folder back and one new job. The numbers come from its run logs.

      
        Day 1oct 8
Empty folder to a playable game: island, roads, houses, cars, villagers, day and night, then the tilt, balloons and eras on a second pass.
79 min of opus · 3,452 lines · 0 assets



        Updateoct 8
Rotate and zoom the camera, 12 buildings with their own weight, 11 quests, a harmony bonus for a level island, gusts of wind, buildings sliding off past 15°, autosave and sound.
24.5 min of opus · $6.81



        Day 2oct 9
From sandbox to arcade: pieces arrive by balloon, a hold slot, combos, a harmony streak, gusts, slides and flips, five chapters with a keeper each, perks, Endless, a Daily island and a share card.
40.7 min of opus · $12.94



        Day 3replies
You asked for a leaderboard on the daily island, so here it is: pick a name, no email, and your best run of the day goes on the board. Daily is open from the start with one twist a day. Also new: a first run that teaches by doing, a gentler first 45 seconds, CHAIN and PERFECT bonuses, and two rare pieces, Glue and the Wind Vane.



        Day 4next
Your ideas from the replies.
